text: Record the cost of hook-driven agent sessions on the ideas they worked on (realizedCostUsd from the session transcript)
description:
Found while settling 675fce29 (2026-11-24): realizedCostUsd only grows from loop-worker harness cycles, but most work on this repo runs through Claude Code (and Codex) sessions driven by the Stop hook, which record nothing. So the calibration (b2a7c3cf) would wait long for 30+ estimate/actual pairs.

Proposal: the Stop hook already gets the session's transcript path. Per turn, sum the token usage in the transcript since the last Stop, price it with harness.json prices (or the CLI's own reported cost where it gives one), and attribute it to the ideas the turn changed (the idea ids in the turn's commits or MCP update calls; split evenly if several). Record via idea.addRealizedCost.

Hypothesis: hook-driven sessions produce most of the realized-cost data within weeks. Refuted if attributing a turn to ideas is too noisy (many ideas per turn, or none).

status.comment: scripts/hooks/record-session-cost.mjs, started by the Stop hook in the background (from the Aimparency checkout named in continue-hook-default, so installed hooks follow updates; never blocks or fails the hook). Per Stop: transcript lines since the last Stop of that session (offset in .bowman/runtime/session-costs.json), usage per model with each API message counted once (by message.id), priced from .bowman/harness.json prices; cache writes split into 5-minute and 1-hour by the transcript's cache_creation; a model without a complete price is logged as unpriced and nothing is recorded. The cost goes evenly to the ideas whose files changed since the last Stop (commits since then + working tree incl. untracked) via POST /idea.addRealizedCost; a log line per Stop in .bowman/runtime/session-costs.log. Prices: harness price schema gained optional cacheReadPerMTok, cacheWritePerMTok, cacheWrite1hPerMTok; .bowman/harness.json has claude-opus-5-5 at $4 in / $20 out / $0.20 cache read / $5 5-min write / $8 1-h write per MTok (from the claude-api reference, cached 2026-11-03). These are API list prices; on a subscription they are the API-equivalent value, not money spent. Evidence: record-session-cost.test.mjs 4/4 (message dedup, 1h split, cache-unpriced stays unknown, changed ideas since a time incl. working tree), hooks contract test PASS, loadHarnessConfig reads the new harness.json, real run on this session: 'claude-opus-5-5 12+3142210r+0w+56422w1h in/4929 out; $1.1784'; pnpm check 25/25. Not yet observed: a Stop that records on a changed idea (the Stop after this commit should put this turn's cost on this idea). Known noise: wrapped agents committing in the same tree within a turn get a share.
